gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: $mote_id})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
MATCH (m)-[:EPOCH_IN]->(e:Epoch {epoch_id: $epoch_id})
WITH m, s
RETURN coalesce(s.mote_id, m.moteid, m.mote_id) AS mote_id, m.time AS time, m.temperature AS temperature, m.humidity AS humidity, m.light AS light, m.voltage AS voltage ORDER BY time, mote_id LIMIT $limit
